USS SILVERSIDES                          PATROL 7
TIME 0539 L     DATE Oct. 18, 1943       LAT 1-00 N     LONG 149-20 E
TARGET DATA - DAMAGE INFLICTED
Description:
Torgot was in convoy formation of thrce columns
line abreast. Two ships in right hand column, two
ships in center column and one ship in left hand
column. Two oscorts of boat type, one patrolling
ahead of formation and one astern. Convoy appeared
to consist of three AK's and three ⟦AP⟧ (or engines aft AK's).
Name of ship attacked from life rings recovered was
TAI⟦_⟧IN MARU. Convoy had been sighted 1415 previous
day and tracked continuously sinco that time. Sea
conditions calm, fairly bright moon.
Ship(s) Sunk: One, AK, estimated 7000 tons, life rings gave name of
ship as TAI⟦_⟧IN MARU, out of KOBE. ONI 208-J does not
list this ship. It appeared to bo largest ship in
formation.
Damago dotormined by: Saw much wrockage and debris. Heard two
torpedoes hit and heard ship break up, amongst debris
wore four landing bargos and two lifoboats. Whon
we saw convoy later ono ship was missing.
Target draft 22 (est)     Course 075     Spoed 9 kts.     Range 2900 yds.
OUR SHIP DATA
Spoed 2.8 kts.     Course 318     Dopth 52     Angle 0

Night submarced periscope approach in bright moon-
light. Moon too bright to remain at radar depth.
Convoy had zigzagged offering shot at three over-
lapping torrets. Range was not favorable, but speed
was accurately known from long period of tracking
and multiple targets counteracted range offect.

DESCRIPTION:
This ship had been previously hit in the engine room
by a torpedo in attack 3. It had been abandoned and
superstructure was in flames, but ship was
not sinking. Attempted to sink by shell fire, firing 82 rounds of
4" 50 cal at ranges from 1500 to 500 yards. The binocular sights in-
stalled during last refit were unsatisfactory in that they soon
jarred loose. Even at close range it was almost impossible to aim.
Was not impressed by effect of shell fire. It would be extremely
difficult to sink a ship of this size with 4" 50 cal gun. Finally
sank ship with torpedo (attack 4).

fields.narrative: Opened fire with deck gun, initial range 1500 yds, then closed to 500 yds. Fired ⟦--⟧ rounds which appeared to have little effect as far as sinking was concerned. It still did not appear to be sinking, and wanted to start closing remainder of convoy so decided to finish the job with a torpedo. GUN ATTACK #1
